howToPlay.title: Spin for your product

howToPlay.title: Brainstorm on the clock
howToPlay.desc: Teams huddle against a countdown to craft their angle, slogan, and big promises.

howToPlay.title: Pitch, vote & crown a winner
howToPlay.desc: Each team delivers their pitch live, everyone votes for their favorite, and the champions get the confetti.

faqs.q: Do we need sales or presentation experience?
faqs.a: Not at all! The products are intentionally absurd, so polish doesn't win — creativity and laughs do. Our host keeps it fun and low-pressure.

faqs.q: How do teams deliver their pitch?
faqs.a: One or more teammates simply unmute and pitch live on Zoom, Teams, or Meet. The host hypes every pitch and runs the voting.

howToPlay.title: Spin for a mystery deck
howToPlay.desc: The wheel hands every team a slide deck they've never laid eyes on.

howToPlay.title: Huddle for a hot minute

howToPlay.title: Present, laugh, vote
howToPlay.desc: Presenters improvise through their slides live, the audience votes, and the smoothest talker takes the crown.

faqs.q: Do we have to create the slides?
faqs.a: Nope — we bring the decks. That's the fun: you improvise a confident presentation of slides you're seeing for the first time.

faqs.q: What if someone is too shy to present?
faqs.a: In team mode a volunteer presents for the group, and teammates can jump in to help. Nobody is ever forced to present solo.
